sections_and_features: Sticky navigation bar with logo, links, favorites badge, and List Property CTA
Hero section with headline 'Find Your Perfect Place to Call Home', filters for location, type, buy/rent, and price
Quick category tabs (Luxury Apartments, Independent Houses, Luxury Villas, Commercial, Residential Plots, Rental)
Featured Property Grid with realistic property cards, badges (Featured, Exclusive, New), quick save, and view details
Advanced interactive search & filtering system with buy/rent toggles, price slider, and instant results
Dedicated Property Detail modal/page with photo gallery, amenities, floor plans, neighborhood info, and inquiry form
About Us section with editable placeholder stats & brand story
Why Choose Us benefits grid with luxury aesthetic
Luxury Properties Showcase with VIP inquiry actions
How It Works 4-step guide for buyers and sellers
List Your Property interactive multi-step modal form
Contact & Location section with interactive map placeholder, validated contact form, and direct WhatsApp inquiry link
Footer with newsletter subscription and quick links
